Alex G: Heads-up — ACME (enterprise) asked us to onboard Skyline-33B into Dedicated for next sprint. They want a quantized variant with latency SLO p95 <= 45ms (single-stream), streaming + function-calling support, and a safety/quality eval run. Can we triage blockers, scope, and rough ETA?

Maya B: Do we have the checkpoint + license? Need HF link or safetensors + tokenizer. Also ask ACME to confirm redistribution/quantization rights.

Arjun K: From infra/ops perspective — rough numbers: Skyline-33B FP16 peak ~55–70GB memory for model states (depends on optimizer/kv strategy), so int8/q4 should fit on 80GB H100 but KV cache matters for long contexts. Proposed triage steps: 1) license + artifacts check 2) minimal compile to validate ops 3) microbench on H100 80GB with flash-attn/triton 4) quant pipeline (q4f16 / q8) + calibration 5) eval/regression suite. ETA for initial perf bench 48–72h given node availability.

Sasha L: I'll take the compile & quant runs. Quick runbook I'll use:
```
# compile to triton-optimized bundle
rw-compiler --model-path ./skyline-33b.safetensors --backend triton --optimize flash_attn --out ./build/skyline-33b-triton

# quantize example (calibration w/ 1k samples)
rw-quantize --input ./skyline-33b.safetensors --out ./skyline-33b-q4f16.safetensors --mode q4f16 --calib-samples 1024

# microbench (batch=1, seq=512)
rw-bench --model ./build/skyline-33b-triton --backend triton --device h100 --batch 1 --seq 512
```
I'll attach logs as I run.

Alex G: Important: customer requires streaming and function-call fidelity. Can quantized model preserve function-call structured output? Also add instruction-following evals and a safety checklist run.

Maya B: Streaming + KV cache must be preserved; quant should not break token alignment but we should verify with the ACME prompt set. They gave 30 prompts so far — we need the full 200 prompt corpus for regression. Also request tokenizer files and any custom special tokens.

Ben R: Prioritization note — ACME is a design partner with a contract signature; this should be high priority. But Private deployment triggers KMS/key policy review and additional networking work. Security will need 48h for KMS sign-off once we have package details.

CI Bot: build-job/skyline-compile-2061122312 started on ci-runner-5 :gear:

- infra quota for multi-node runs (we need 2xH100 for replication)

Target: initial quant + eval results posted in this thread by 2061122445.
